videos.title: Relationship Therapist: The Hidden Question Behind Every Small Argument You Have | Esther Perel
videos.description:
Most fights in a relationship aren't about the dishes. They're about the fear of losing each other, or of losing yourself.

In this episode, Esther Perel and Jay Shetty talk about why, in so many couples, one partner is more afraid of losing the other and the other is more afraid of losing themselves. Esther explains why most power struggles in a relationship are not really about power at all.

Jay shares how a small disagreement over when to do the dishes turned into "you don't appreciate me," and how he once turned his wife's tough day into a competition over whose week was harder. Esther tells the story of a fight with her husband in the car after almost 40 years of marriage, and what it showed her about blaming a partner when you feel helpless.

They also talk about the craving after a breakup, how to trust your own judgment again after a betrayal, and the stages couples go through to rebuild trust after an affair.

Learn why the need to win every argument is so often fear in disguise. And learn the small shift that makes your partner feel like part of your story instead of on hold.
